title: ANOTR & 54 Ultra’s ‘Talk to You’ Spends a Second Week Atop WARM Global Dance Radio Chart
summary: The chart ranks the top dance tracks worldwide, based on monitored airplay across 200-plus dance stations in more than 30 countries.
contentText:
ANOTR’s “Talk to You,” featuring 54 Ultra, adds a second week at No. 1 on the WARM Global Dance Radio chart (dated April 18), as it drew more than 800 plays (up 7% week over week) across 200-plus monitored stations worldwide April 3-9, according to World Airplay Radio Monitor.

Released March 6 via ANOTR’s own NO ART imprint, the song has built momentum on TikTok, where it has been featured in nearly 50,000 videos .

“Talk to You” has also become a hit across Billboard ’s other U.S.-based charts, reaching No. 5 on Hot Dance/Electronic Songs and ranking at No. 8 this week. In the latest tracking week, it drew 1.1 million official U.S. streams, according to Luminate.

ANOTR is an Amsterdam-based electronic duo comprising Oguzhan Guney and Jesse van der Heijden.

Bebe Rexha and Faithless’ “New Religion” surges 4-2 for a new WARM Global Dance Radio high (up 32% in plays); Calvia Harris and Kasabian’s “Release the Pressure” holds at No. 3 after four weeks on top; Milky X Mall Grab’s “Just the Way You Are” falls 2-4; and FISHER’s “Rain” keeps at No. 5.

The top debut on the chart is Prospa and Cloonee’s “Free Your Mind” at No. 11. The song is slated to appear on Prospa’s upcoming debut album, Free Your Mind .

David Guetta has the most songs on the latest chart, with five: “Save Me Tonight,” with Jennifer Lopez (No. 8); “Upside Down,” with Jaden Bojsen (No. 20); “Crazy,” with Matt Sassari and Amira Eldine (also billed to Guetta’s DJ alias, Jack Back); “Beautiful People,” with Sia (No. 81 debut); and “Walked Away,” with Hypaton (No. 96 debut).

The WARM Global Dance Radio chart debuted on Billboard.com in March, joining Billboard’s long-standing U.S.-based dance lists, including Hot Dance/Electronic Songs, Hot Dance/Pop Songs, Dance/Mix Show Airplay and Top Dance Albums. The 40-position Global Dance Radio chart (published in full as a 100-position ranking on WARM’s platform) aggregates plays from 200-plus dance-dedicated radio stations across more than 30 countries, reflecting songs trending globally through a network of programmers and radio gatekeepers operating across multiple territories.

Check out the top 40 of the WARM Global Dance Radio chart on Billboard.com and head over to WARM’s website for the full 100-position survey.
